title: WASM Matrix Operations

tasks.description: Element-wise operations (WASM) - implement add, subtract, multiply, divide in AssemblyScript with SIMD
Matrix transpose (WASM) - implement cache-blocked transpose for large matrices
Matrix multiplication (WASM) - implement matmul with tiled algorithm and SIMD vectorization
SIMD optimizations - add SIMD (v128) intrinsics for parallel processing of f64x2 vectors
Bind WASM to Backend - connect WASM functions to WASMBackend class interface
Performance benchmarks - create benchmarks comparing JS vs WASM for various matrix sizes
WASM operation tests - verify correctness of WASM operations against JS reference

successCriteria: WASM matmul 5-10x faster than JS for 1000x1000 matrices
WASM operations produce identical results to JS
SIMD code path activates when available
Memory usage stays bounded for large matrices
notes: Sprint 6 implements the core matrix operations in AssemblyScript WASM with SIMD optimization. Added element-wise multiply/divide, SIMD-optimized versions of all element-wise operations using v128/f64x2, updated WASMBackend to use SIMD when available, created comprehensive benchmarks and operation tests. All 160 matrix tests pass. Note: Operations are implemented in matrix/assembly/matrix/multiply.ts rather than separate files as originally planned.
